title: dataset-row
description: One JSONL row: g = group_id, u = unit_id, x = features, y = training target, c = label confidence, s = label source, l = label in the source (e.g. 3-class) space when y is a projection, w (v1.1) = evaluation weight: the unit's own-text length in Unicode code points (NFC, whitespace collapsed), declared by the manifest's row_weight. No format envelope (one object per line).

x.description: Features after static transform, BEFORE fitted normalization.
